steps: Identify the parts of a typical leaf: leaf base, petiole, and lamina.
The petiole is the stalk that connects the leaf to the stem.
The lamina (or leaf blade) is the green, expanded part of the leaf.
The lamina contains veins and veinlets which provide rigidity and act as channels for transport.
Therefore, the green expanded part of the leaf with veins and veinlets is the lamina.
